titulo.estudio: Des consignes à plusieurs étapes : Observer les formes

intro: Follow a complex instruction and recognise exceptions, conditions and time order. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

frases.estudio: Joignez les annexes dans l'ordre demandé, sauf celles qui contiennent des données confidentielles; celles-ci doivent être déposées séparément.
frases.alumno: Attach the annexes in the order requested, except those containing confidential data; these must be submitted separately.

frases.estudio: Si une pièce manque, enregistrez le brouillon sans l'envoyer et ajoutez une note précisant le délai prévu.
frases.alumno: If a document is missing, save the draft without sending it and add a note giving the expected deadline.

piezas.titulo: Reading the vocabulary and the forms
texto: Follow a complex instruction and recognise exceptions, conditions and time order. Tell apart claims, evidence and reservations; attribute each piece of data to its source before drawing a conclusion.
Watch out: conditional and time clauses set out when each instruction applies; pay attention to the scope of negatives. In this passage, «sauf» means «except».
